summary: Quality lifecycle exposes resumable Run lineage choice to the user instead of resolving it internally.
expected: The Harness should internally reuse a safe resumable Run when the target, source snapshot, and lifecycle intent match; user intervention should be reserved for genuinely protected or ambiguous operations.
actual: The quality command stopped at preflight with ACTIVE_LOGICAL_RUN_CONFLICT and required the user to choose between resuming the existing Run and creating a replacement Run, even though the existing Run was ready, had no submissions or findings, and had no active lease.

steps: Submit the bound command h:engine quality V3.8.4.
Allow the Harness to resolve the quality/full intent and run action-scoped preflight.
Observe that a ready Run with the same target and source snapshot is reported as a conflict.
Observe that the adapter asks the user to authorize resume versus replacement instead of applying an internal lineage policy.

excerpts.text: 首先，我觉得恢复既有 Run还是新建 Run 应该是你在执行过程中就能判断出来的。其次，我启动了harness后，这种决策不应该交由我来判断以及授权，我觉得这个应该是Harness的一个内部行为，不应该由我来介入
Action-scoped preflight reported ACTIVE_LOGICAL_RUN_CONFLICT for an existing ready quality Run; all other readiness checks, including the atomic control-root write probe, were ready.
